name: Golem Girl
source:
An artificial monster created by magic science. Having no will of its own, it simply guards the castle like it was instructed to by its creators. Those with permission to enter the castle need to blow on a special whistle in order for her to allow them to pass. In addition, she is instructed not to chase after anyone who retreats.

Where her genitals would be, she is equipped with a special hole designed to process male semen. Any male inserted into her to be used as a power source will be quickly drained and left weak. As the males are usually condemned prisoners, they are used to power the Golem Girl until their death. This inhuman act appears to be carried out with neither the king’s nor the citizens’ knowledge.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
